title: Provide configuration properties for Flyway's Vault and Conjur support

timeline.message:
Add configuration properties for Flyway Vault and Conjur support

Fixes gh-24969
timeline.author: bono007

reply.body:
The method reference does not work when executing against the 5.x/6.x older `FluentConfiguration` which does not have the `conjur**` or `vault**` mutators. Regardless of the value being null, at runtime the method reference still attempts to get resolved at which time a NoSuchMethod gets thrown. This is why the file is littered w/ comments like this ```No method reference for compatibility with Flyway 6.x```. 

To see this in action run `org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.flyway.Flyway5xAutoConfigurationTests` or `org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.flyway.Flyway6xAutoConfigurationTests`.

timeline.body: Configuration properties documentation don't start with "The" or "A". Please look at other description in this file (and others) for inspiration and [this section of the reference guide](https://docs.spring.io/spring-boot/docs/current/reference/htmlsingle/#boot-features-custom-starter-configuration-keys).

timeline.body:
I'd prefer that the setup remains in each test and that the thing that's shared is the real assertion in the form of a `ContextConsumer`. 

A good example of what I am trying to convey is  in [`EnvironmentEndpointAutoConfigurationTests`](https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-boot/blob/1bd603f3aa48f29807db19dc85d9a7140214df0c/spring-boot-project/spring-boot-actuator-autoconfigure/src/test/java/org/springframework/boot/actuate/autoconfigure/env/EnvironmentEndpointAutoConfigurationTests.java#L62-L87).
Thanks for the PR Chris. I've added a few notes, can you please have look?

timeline.author: bono007

timeline.body: @snicoll thx for the suggestion. Keeping the setup in each test makes it easy to see what the test is doing from first glance. Sharing only the common validation reduces the duplicated lines (and that was the main goal of the first attempt). 👍🏻
This line should be deleted as well please.
